def facts():
    used = DEV.dram.used
    s = ST.Storage(DEV, 64)
    f1 = s.form(FM.F16, 32)
    same = s.form(FM.F16, 32) is f1
    s.made(FM.F16)
    f3 = s.form(FM.F16, 128)
    regrown = f3.nbytes == 128 and f3 is not f1 and FM.F16 not in s.valid
    at = ST.StorageView(s, 32, 16).addr - s.addr
    s.free()
    return {"same": same, "regrown": regrown, "view_at": at, "freed": DEV.dram.used == used}
